notes.title: Patch: Fixing Vomitoreum Launching Other Games
notes.notes:
Sorry for the year and a half delay on this, I got sort of distracted (and lazy). Vomitoreum should no longer launch other games (like Doom, Doom II, Heretic, Hexen, etc. etc.) when opening the game.

Thought I'd do this during a lull period, if you manage to see this before updating you may want to back up your current build to finish your playthrough, since updating GZDoom games wipes save data.

Hope this helps, again, sorry it took so long!

notes.title: Bug Fix Galore
notes.notes:
Meowdy! I hope you all are enjoying the game.

I've been spending the last few hours fixing most of what you all have reported.

Here's a list of the shit I fixeded:

-Fixed that fucking piece of shit invuse keybind (I really hope!)
-Vomitoreum and Umadermadine framerate improved
-No longer can hear player actions during critical cutscenes
-Improves telegraphs for certain game mechanics
-Vomitoreum no longer repeats dialogue
-Fixed Sister boss not completing issue caused by them damaging eachother
-Sisters no longer damage eachother
-Improved visuals on intro segment
-Blacksmith door close bug fixed
-Fixed Bunkerblocks counting as enemies
-Bug fixes across the board

I will continue to fix the game more and more over time, but I hope this cuts out a lot of the main issues y'all are experiencin' right now.

Thank you for playing the game!
